operations.summary: Start external migration out for compute
operations.description:
Initiates **peer-to-peer live migration** of the specified compute (VM)
**from the current source host to an external target host**.

Behavior:
- Uses libvirt `migrateToURI3` over `qemu+ssh://<target>/system` with the following flags:
  - `LIVE`, `PEER2PEER`, `PERSIST_DEST`, `UNDEFINE_SOURCE`, `CHANGE_PROTECTION`, `AUTO_CONVERGE`.
  - Adds `NON_SHARED_DISK` automatically when `diskmap` is provided (copying block devices to the target).
  - Adds `UNSAFE` only if `use_unsafe=true` (forces migration even if libvirt considers it unsafe).
- Clones and adjusts the source domain XML for the destination:
  - Remaps disk paths via `diskmap` and CD/DVD images via `cdrommap`.
  - Controls graphics devices via `graphics` (see parameter doc).
  - Preserves the original UUID; the name is preserved unless `new_name` is specified.
- Pre-flight checks on the destination:
  - Fails if a domain with the **same UUID** already exists.
  - Fails if an **active** domain with the same `new_name`/source name exists;
    logs a warning if a **shut-off** domain exists (it may be overwritten).
- Waits until the source domain has **no active libvirt job** before starting.
- On success, the VM is **persisted on the destination** and **undefined on the source**.

Returns:
- A string async job ID representing the scheduled external migration-out task.

Notes:
- `target` must be reachable via SSH for `qemu+ssh` and should not include the URI scheme.
- Use of `use_unsafe=true` may bypass safety checks and can lead to data inconsistency. Use with caution.

parameters.name: cdrommap
parameters.description:
Mapping for CD/DVD devices or their source paths to new ISO/device paths on the destination. Example:
```
{ "hdc": "/var/lib/libvirt/iso/installer.iso" }
```

parameters.name: compute_id
parameters.description: ID of the compute instance to migrate.

parameters.name: diskmap
parameters.description:
Mapping of **guest disk target names** to **absolute paths** on the destination host.
Enables non-shared-storage migration (copies blocks). Example:
```
{ "vda": "/var/lib/libvirt/images/vm1-system.qcow2",
  "vdb": "/vmstore/vm1-data.qcow2" }
```

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description:
Graphics handling on the destination:
- `<address>`: set graphics listen address (e.g., `10.0.0.12` or `spicegw.example.com`).
  The destination XML will have `listen=<address>` and `autoport=yes`.

parameters.name: netmap
parameters.description:
Mapping for network interfaces. Matching interface by MAC for replacing port info from source to target.
Supported two types nodes:
- node.network_mode: bridge -> source_type = "bridge"
- node.network_mode: ovs -> source_type = "network"
Example:
```
{"52:54:00:00:06:39": {"target_dev": "ce-888-1", "source_type": "network", "source_value": "ext-0047"}}
```

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: Optional new domain name on the destination. If omitted, the source name is preserved.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description:
Remote libvirt host to connect to (inserted into `qemu+ssh://{target}/system`).
Format: `"[user@]host[:port]"` (no URI scheme). Example: `root@hv02.example.com`.

parameters.name: use_unsafe
parameters.description:
When `true`, adds libvirt's `UNSAFE` flag to force migration even if libvirt marks it unsafe.
**Not recommended** unless you fully understand the risks (possible data loss).

operations.summary: Stop Compute for external migration in
operations.description:
Stops an incoming external migration for the specified compute instance.

Behavior and usage notes:
- This operation is allowed only when the VM is currently in the `MIGRATING_IN` status.
- If `new_vm_uuid` is provided:
  * This indicates that the external migration completed on the target host.
  * The platform will search for a VM with the given UUID on the host.
    - If the VM is found, it will be transitioned to `STARTED`.
    - If the VM is NOT found, the async job will fail a error.

  * Treat this case with caution — it is intended for situations where the migration did not happen
  and the user only wants to release reserved resources and set the model to `STOPPED`.
  * If you call the API *after* a migration but omit `new_vm_uuid`, the platform will set the model to `STOPPED`
  and perform cleanup. The actual VM may still exist on the target host
  but will no longer be represented in the platform (i.e. it becomes unmanaged by the platform).

- A string async job ID representing the scheduled stop/transition operation.

operations.summary: Stop Compute for external migration out
operations.description:
Stops an ongoing external migration **out** and finalizes the Compute state.

Behavior:
- Runs **only** when the Compute is in the `MIGRATING_OUT` status.
- If `migrate_to_uri3_job_id` is provided:
  - Attempts to gracefully abort the active migration on the source.
  - Checks the actual migration result:
    - If the migration **completed successfully**,
      performs cleanup of resources and sets the Compute to `STOPPED`.
    - If the migration **did not complete** (aborted/failed/in progress),
      sets the Compute back to `STARTED`.
- If `migrate_to_uri3_job_id` is **omitted**:
  - Performs cleanup of resources and sets the Compute to `STOPPED`
    **without** attempting to cancel or verify migration progress.
    Use with care.

Typical usage:
- Automatically invoked to finalize after migration workflows (success or failure).
- For manual interruption, provide `migrate_to_uri3_job_id` to trigger cancellation and finalize accordingly.

Returns:
- A string async job ID representing the stop/finalization operation for migration-out.

parameters.name: migrate_to_uri3_job_id
parameters.description:
Identifier of the agent-side external migration (LibvirtMigrateToURI3Request) job.
If provided, the endpoint first attempts to cancel the migration before finalizing.
If omitted, only cleanup is performed and the Compute is set to `STOPPED`.

- netId - id of VINS, EXTNET or VFNIC, any for EMPTY and SDN

- sdn_interface_id - unique_identifier of LogicalPort on SDN side.

- sdn_segment_id - LogicalPort.segment_id (required field for create new LogicalPort).
- optional sdn_logical_port_display_name - LogicalPort.display_name
(If not set, autogenerate like {compute.name}-{id}).
- optional sdn_logical_port_description - LogicalPort.description
(If not set, autogenerate like {compute.name}-{id}).
- optional sdn_object_group_ids - Array Ids of Network Object Group on SDN side
(need for attaching LogicalPort to Network Object Groups).

If not specified, compute will be created with default interface from RG.

Number of checks that the server must pass in order to get
the available status and be included in the balancing scheme again

parameters.name: slowstart

Interval in milliseconds from the moment the server receives
the available status, after which the number of actually allowed
